+[word/document.xml] 2. Critical On-Field Safety & Turf Protection Rules

+[word/document.xml] • Non-Locking Casters & Ground Chocking: Carts use non-locking swivel casters for rapid rolling agility. When positioned at drill coordinates in breezy conditions, place extra double-bagged 15-lb sandbags on the turf firmly against wheels as wheel chocks to prevent roll drift.

+[word/document.xml] • Hand Placement & Low Leverage: Always push from the lower 2x4 wooden cart base framing. NEVER push, pull, or climb on the upright steel pipes or diagonal struts, which introduces severe overturning tipping leverage.

+[word/document.xml] • Mandatory Double-Bagging (Rule 8.05): All 15-lb sandbags must have intact heavy-duty plastic inner liners. Never bring single-layer bags onto athletic turf. Carts must not exceed 300 lbs total (~75 lb/wheel) to prevent rubber infill rutting.

+[word/document.xml] • High-Wind Emergency Abort: If severe gusts strike on-field, handlers immediately brace against the upwind 2x4 base. Authorized parent crew (with Rule 9.07 Field Pass wristbands) will assist to lay props flat on turf if ordered by directors.

+[word/document.xml] • Unloading & Staging (Reverse of Loading): 1) Unstrap carts from trailer nose wall & lower from short ends; 2) Retrieve 10'×8' frames from cross support beams; 3) Pull off protective tennis balls from upper struts (stow in tote); 4) Rapidly bolt frame to cart using cordless power driver with socket; 5) Mate 2-piece struts and lock quick-release retaining pins; 6) Stage required ballast & wheel chocks.

+[word/document.xml] • Teardown & Trailer Packing: 1) Immediate de-ballasting at stadium exit chute; 2) Stack sandbags low over trailer axles; 3) Pull strut retaining pins (stow in tote); 4) Lower strut arm folds flat on cart; 5) Install protective tennis balls over upper strut ends; 6) Unbolt frame using cordless power driver (stow bolts in tote); 7) Slide frames onto trailer cross beams; 8) Stand carts vertically on short ends strapped against front nose wall.
